title.value: NL-PS-L4-B - Level 4b: Two maximal GBBs per section - Patient id query

description.value: The serving system provides an NL-PS for its level 4b test patient, in which every mandatory section except Medication summary has at least two entries, each with a maximal generic building block (GBB), and has a narrative, and Medication summary has no entries, and has an emptyReason and a narrative. Conformancelab searches the Patient Summary of the Patient id you enter at test setup. Enter the id of your level 4b test patient, without 'Patient/'. Implementation Guides: NL-PS https://ig.nictiz.nl/nlps/ and generic building blocks (GBB) https://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/
Patient.id of your level 4b test patient, without 'Patient/'.
Search the NL-PS Composition of the test patient with the Patient id entered at test setup.
